name: Right to Information Act
description: Grants citizens the right to request information from public authorities, promoting transparency and accountability in governance.
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions

name: Citizenship Amendment Act
description: Amends citizenship eligibility rules for persecuted religious minorities from Afghanistan, Bangladesh, and Pakistan who entered India before 2015.

name: Goods and Services Tax Act
description: Unified indirect tax law that replaced multiple central and state taxes with a single tax structure across India.

name: Information Technology Act
description: Provides legal recognition for electronic transactions and addresses cybercrime and data protection in India.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology

name: National Investigation Agency Act
description: Established the National Investigation Agency as India's central counter-terrorism law enforcement agency.

name: Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act
description: Mandates free and compulsory education for children aged 6 to 14 years as a fundamental right.

name: Companies Act
description: Governs incorporation, regulation, and dissolution of companies in India, replacing the Companies Act of 1956.

name: Consumer Protection Act
description: Protects consumer rights and establishes authorities to address unfair trade practices and consumer complaints.
ministry: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution

name: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita
description: Replaced the Indian Penal Code as India's primary criminal law, effective from 2024.

name: Digital Personal Data Protection Act
description: Regulates the processing of digital personal data and establishes data protection obligations for organizations.
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
